messages:
akira: FYI we just got a sudden burst of long-running GPU batch jobs from the research cluster in eu-west1 (starts ~5m ago). Autoscaler started scaling but a lot of nodes are stuck in PROVISIONING. pending pods climbing fast. @jamie can you check nodepool/quota?
jamie: on it. I'm seeing node_provision_time spike to 180s and GCE returns a bunch of errors. digging.
infra-bot: [cluster-eu-west1] event: InstanceCreationFailed (ZONE_RESOURCE_POOL_EXHAUSTED). 12 failures in last 3m.
priya: ugh zone exhausted again? did we fallback to another zone/region?
daniel: autoscaler logs show repeated scale-up attempts then immediate cooldown cancels -> thrash. scale_request_rate high but available_node_count stays low.
akira: exact metrics: scale_requests=18, pending_pods=46, avg_startup=170s, spot_evictions=3. jobs are GPU-heavy (A100).
jamie: quota for A100 in eu-west1 is at commit cap. cloud console shows remaining=0 for requested machine type. provisioning errors line up with quota.
priya: options: 1) reroute new job submissions to us-west1 (has spare capacity) 2) temporarily allow on-demand (higher cost) in eu-west1 3) wait for cloud pool to replenish (ETA unknown).
daniel: agree. Can we flip routing for job queue? quick hack: add region preference to queue router, fallback to us-west1.
akira: how invasive is that change? we want minimal blast radius.
jamie: small proxy change to job-scheduler: add fallback_regions=["us-west1"] for heavy_gpu_queue. I can push a canary.
priya: also, increase autoscaler retry window and reduce cool-down aggressiveness for this nodepool so we don't oscillate during provisioning delays. set cool_down=90 -> 45s? that could reduce cancels.
daniel: be careful reducing cooldown too much will thrash more. better: increase scale_up_grace_period to cover node_provision_time (set to 240s) so autoscaler treats nodes as in-flight.
jamie: applying quick config: 
```
# scheduler patch (canary)
PATCH /internal/scheduler/config
{ "queues": { "heavy_gpu": { "fallback_regions": ["us-west1"] } } }
```
jamie: applied canary to 10% of traffic.
infra-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout started for scheduler-config v2025.04-canary to 10%
deploy-bot: rollout success for 10% (ok=2, failed=0)
akira: I'm seeing new jobs landing in us-west1 now. pending_pods in eu-west1 still ~40, but growth slowed.
jamie: triggered manual request to cloud support for A100 quota increase and resource pool check (ticket #CLOUD-4821).
priya: i also pushed autoscaler tweak to nodepool: scale_up_grace_period=240s, cool_down_window=120s (can rollback). keep monitoring.
daniel: ran quick kubectl to see pod states: 
```
kubectl get pods -n ml-batch --field-selector=status.phase=Pending
NAME                      READY   STATUS    NODE
job-a-xyz                 0/1     Pending   <none> (insufficient resources)
job-b-abc                 0/1     Pending   <none> (waiting for gpu)
```
jamie: cloud console now shows some on-demand instances provisioning to bypass spot shortages; cost hit but buys time.
akira: cost team FYI — we will use on-demand for ~30-60m in eu-west1 if needed. Expect a spike in infra spend.
infra-bot: [monitoring] spike detected: infra.cost.estimate.delta = +0.18% last 15m due to on-demand fallback.
priya: status update: pending_pods down to 12, scale_requests steady at 3, nodepool in eu-west1 stabilized. us-west1 handled ~22 jobs.
daniel: recommend followups: 1) add region-capacity-aware scheduling to avoid single-region exhaustion, 2) create runbook for A100 quota exhaustion, 3) tune autoscaler defaults for long-provision GPU types.
akira: agreed. I'll open tasks and assign. reopening infra postmortem if cloud ticket has long lead.
jamie: closing immediate incident. continuing monitoring for 2h.
priya: thanks all :thumbsup:
akira: thanks — great cross-team run. will post summary in #incidents if anything new.
summary: Autoscaler had scale-up cancellations and node provisioning failures during a sudden surge of A100 GPU batch jobs in eu-west1. Root causes: zone resource exhaustion and strict autoscaler cooldown interacting with long node_provision_time. Actions: canary job-router fallback to us-west1, autoscaler grace period increase, temporary on-demand fallback, cloud quota ticket opened, cost team notified. Monitoring continues.
